points.t: 主格當主詞，受格當受詞
points.p: 主格：I、you、he、she、it、we、they，放在動詞前面當主詞。受格：me、you、him、her、it、us、them，放在動詞或介系詞後面。

points.t: 介系詞後面一定用受格
points.p: with me、for her、to us、about them：不能說 with I、for she。

drills.q: Please call ___ tomorrow.
drills.why: 動詞後面的受詞用受格 me。

drills.q: ___ are my classmates.
The doctor talked to we about the results.
accept: The doctor talked to us about the results.
drills.why: 介系詞 to 後面用受格 us。

points.t: 所有代名詞＝所有格＋名詞
points.p: mine、yours、his、hers、ours、theirs 後面不接名詞，自己就代表「…的東西」：This bag is mine.（＝my bag）
Your room is bigger than ours.（ours＝our room），避免重複名詞。

ex.en: Your room is bigger than ours.
My score is lower than hers.

drills.q: That car isn't my car. It's ___.
drills.why: 單獨用、後面沒有名詞，用 hers。

drills.q: Their house is old, but ___ is new.
The red pen is my and the blue one is yours.
accept: The red pen is mine and the blue one is yours.
The red pen is mine, and the blue one is yours.

points.t: 主詞和受詞是同一個人時用反身代名詞
points.p: She hurt herself.（她傷到自己）／Help yourself.（請自便）。單數 -self，複數 -selves。

points.t: 有些動詞不用反身代名詞
points.p: relax、feel、meet、shower、wash（洗澡）通常不加：I feel tired.（不是 feel myself）、Let's meet at six.

mistakes.bad: He looked at him in the mirror.（他看鏡子裡的自己）
mistakes.good: He looked at himself in the mirror.
mistakes.why: 看的是自己，用反身代名詞 himself。

drills.q: We enjoyed ___ at the party.
drills.why: 主詞 we 和受詞是同一群人，用 ourselves。

drills.q: Please help ___ to some cake.
The old man fell and hurt him.（傷到自己）
accept: The old man fell and hurt himself.

points.p: 反身代名詞放在主詞後或句尾，強調「親自、本人」：I made this cake myself.／The doctor herself called me.

ex.zh: 這個蛋糕是我自己做的。

points.p: by myself＝alone 或 without help：She lives by herself.／Can you walk by yourself?

ex.en: Can you walk to the bathroom by yourself?
ex.zh: 你可以自己走去廁所嗎？

drills.q: He fixed the computer ___. Nobody helped him.
My grandmother can't go out by ___.
The children cleaned the room by theirselves.
accept: The children cleaned the room by themselves.
drills.why: they 的反身代名詞是 themselves。

points.p: 兩個人或更多人互相做同一件事：Tom and Amy love each other.（湯姆愛艾美，艾美也愛湯姆）

ex.en: Tom and Amy love each other.

points.p: They looked at each other.（互看）／They looked at themselves.（各看自己）。one another 意思一樣，比較正式。

ex.en: They looked at each other and laughed.

mistakes.bad: We talked each other on the phone.
mistakes.good: We talked to each other on the phone.
mistakes.why: talk to 某人，each other 前面要有 to。

drills.q: The two sisters call ___ every day.
drills.why: 姊妹互相打電話，用 each other。

drills.q: Lisa and I have known ___ for ten years.
The players shook hands with themselves after the game.
accept: The players shook hands with each other after the game.
The players shook hands with one another after the game.
drills.why: 握手是互相的，用 each other。

points.p: This is my mother.（介紹人）／Is that your car?／These are for you.
that 常代替剛剛說的話或事情：That's a good idea.／That's why I was late.

ex.en: You want to rest? That's a good idea.
The bus was late. That's why I was late.
ex.zh: 公車遲到了，所以我才遲到。

drills.q: Hello, ___ is Amy speaking.（電話中）
drills.why: 電話裡自稱用 this is ...。

drills.q: Look at ___ over there. They're so tall!
That are my glasses.
accept: Those are my glasses.

points.p: someone（某人）、anything（任何事）、nobody（沒有人）、everything（所有事）。和 some／any 一樣，肯定句用 some-，否定和問句用 any-。
Everyone is here.（不是 are）／Nobody knows. 形容詞放在後面：something hot、nothing special。

ex.en: I want something hot to drink.

mistakes.why: everybody 後面的動詞用單數。

drills.q: I didn't see ___ in the hallway.
Is there ___ interesting on TV?
drills.why: 形容詞放在 something 後面：something interesting。

drills.q: Nobody know the answer.
accept: Nobody knows the answer.

points.p: who 問人（Who is your doctor?）、what 問東西或事情（What happened?）、which 問從幾個裡選哪一個（Which is yours?）。
whom 問受詞，比較正式，口語多用 who：Whom did you meet?／Who did you meet? whose 問「誰的」：Whose is this?

ex.en: Who did you see at the clinic?

drills.q: ___ is the capital of Japan?
___ do you prefer, tea or coffee?
What is your favorite singer?
accept: Who is your favorite singer?

points.t: 關係代名詞：把兩句接成一句
points.p: I have a friend. She is a nurse. → I have a friend who is a nurse. who 代替前面的 a friend，同時把句子接起來。

ex.en: I have a friend who is a nurse.
ex.zh: 我有一個當護理師的朋友。

ex.en: This is the book that I bought.

points.t: who 指人，which 指東西，that 兩種都可以
points.p: the patient who fell、the medicine which (that) he takes。詳細用法在第 27 章。

ex.en: The patient who fell is now in bed.
ex.zh: 跌倒的那位病人現在躺在床上。

ex.en: The pills that he takes are small.

mistakes.bad: The man which lives next door is a doctor.
mistakes.good: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
mistakes.why: 指人用 who（或 that），不用 which。

drills.q: The girl ___ sits next to me is Lisa.
I lost the watch ___ my father gave me.
She is the nurse which helped my mother.
accept: She is the nurse who helped my mother.
She is the nurse that helped my mother.
drills.why: 指人用 who 或 that。

points.t: one 代替單數，ones 代替複數
points.p: 不想重複可數名詞時用 one／ones：This cup is dirty. Can I have a clean one?／I like the red ones.

ex.en: This cup is dirty. Can I have a clean one?
ex.zh: 這個杯子髒了，可以給我一個乾淨的嗎？

points.t: 不可數名詞不能用 one
points.p: I don't like cold water. I want warm water.（不說 warm one）

ex.en: I don't want cold milk. I want warm milk.
ex.zh: 我不要冰牛奶，我要溫的。

ex.en: Do you want a big box or a small one?

mistakes.bad: I need a new bag. My old is broken.
mistakes.good: I need a new bag. My old one is broken.
mistakes.why: 形容詞 old 後面要接 one，不能單獨用。

drills.q: These gloves are too small. Do you have bigger ___?
drills.why: 代替複數 gloves 用 ones。

drills.q: My phone is old. I want a new ___.
drills.why: 代替單數 phone 用 one。

drills.q: I don't like this shirt. I prefer the blue.
accept: I don't like this shirt. I prefer the blue one.
drills.why: the blue 後面要加 one。

points.t: you 和 we 泛指一般人
points.p: 口語常用 you 表示「任何人」：You should wash your hands often. we 包含說話的人：We all make mistakes.

ex.en: You should wash your hands often.

points.p: they 指「別人、有關單位」：They say the new hospital is great. one 很正式：One should always be polite.

ex.en: They say it will rain tomorrow.

ex.zh: 一個人應該永遠有禮貌。（正式）

mistakes.why: 用 one 開頭就要一致用 one's；口語可改成 You must do your best.

drills.q: In Taiwan, ___ drive on the right side of the road.
___ say this restaurant is very good.
You should always do one's homework.
accept: You should always do your homework.
drills.why: 主詞是 you，後面也用 your。

points.t: it 指前面說過的東西或事情
points.p: I bought a cake. It was delicious.（it＝the cake）／He failed the test. It made him sad.（it＝這件事）

ex.en: I bought a cake. It was delicious.
ex.zh: 我買了一個蛋糕，很好吃。

points.t: 虛指 it：天氣、時間、距離
points.p: 沒有實際意思，只是佔主詞的位置：It's raining.／It's eight o'clock.／It's 5 km to the hospital.

ex.en: It's three kilometers to the station.

mistakes.why: 英文要有主詞，天氣用虛指 it。

drills.q: What time is ___?
___ is a long way to the hospital.
Is very windy today.
accept: It is very windy today.
It's very windy today.
drills.why: 天氣句子要用 it 當主詞。

points.p: 說「某一個人」但不知道或不需要說性別：If a patient needs help, they can press the button.／Someone left their phone.

ex.en: If a patient needs help, they can press the button.
ex.zh: 病人需要幫忙時，可以按按鈕。

points.p: 單數 they 的動詞用複數形：Ask the new nurse. They are in room 2.

ex.en: Ask the new nurse. They are in room 2.
ex.zh: 問那位新護理師，他在二號房。

ex.en: Every student should bring their own lunch.
ex.zh: 每個學生都要帶自己的午餐。

mistakes.bad: Someone forgot his or her umbrella.（不自然）
mistakes.why: 現代英文常用 their 代替 his or her，比較自然。

drills.q: Each nurse must wash ___ hands before entering.
A friend called, but ___ didn't leave a message.
drills.why: 不知道性別的單一個人可以用 they。

drills.q: If anyone calls, tell it I'm busy.
accept: If anyone calls, tell them I'm busy.
drills.why: 指人不能用 it，用 them。

points.t: 代名詞要跟它代替的名詞一致
points.p: 單數配單數、複數配複數、人配人：The nurses finished their work.／The hospital opened its new wing.

ex.en: The hospital opened its new wing.

points.t: 集合名詞和 each 要注意
points.p: The team won its game.（美式當一個整體）／Each of the boys has his own room.

ex.en: Each of the girls brought her own lunch.
ex.zh: 每個女孩都帶了自己的午餐。

mistakes.bad: The students left his books here.
mistakes.good: The students left their books here.

drills.q: The dog wagged ___ tail.
My parents sold ___ old car.
The children washed his hands.
accept: The children washed their hands.

points.t: and 連起來時，看位置決定主格或受格
points.p: 當主詞：My sister and I went shopping.（不是 me）。當受詞或在介系詞後：She invited my sister and me.／between you and me。

ex.en: My sister and I went shopping.
This is between you and me.

points.p: She is taller than me.（口語）／taller than I am（完整）。電話裡 It's me. 很自然；It is I. 非常正式。

ex.en: He runs faster than I do.

mistakes.why: 當主詞用 I，禮貌上把自己放後面。

drills.q: The teacher gave Amy and ___ a prize.
drills.why: 當受詞用 me（去掉 Amy and：gave me）。

drills.q: Lisa and ___ are going to the movies.
Please keep this between you and I.
accept: Please keep this between you and me.
drills.why: 介系詞 between 後面用受格 me。

points.p: My brother he is a nurse. 錯在主詞說了兩次；說 My brother is a nurse. 就好。

ex.en: The man who called you is my uncle.
ex.zh: 打給你的那個人是我叔叔。

points.p: Tom told Ben that he was late. he 是誰不清楚。改成 Tom told Ben, "You are late." 或直接說名字。

ex.en: When Amy met Lisa, Lisa was crying.
ex.zh: 艾美遇到麗莎時，麗莎在哭。

mistakes.bad: The patient in room 5 he needs water.
mistakes.good: The patient in room 5 needs water.
mistakes.why: 主詞已經是 the patient in room 5，不要再加 he。

drills.q: 哪一句沒有重複主詞？___
「Amy called Lisa because she was sick.」哪裡可能不清楚？___
drills.why: she 可能是 Amy 也可能是 Lisa。

drills.q: My best friend she lives in Japan.
accept: My best friend lives in Japan.
drills.why: 主詞 my best friend 已經有了，去掉 she。
